\caption{Retrieval-adapted attribution-quality metrics on 80 hand-selected query--candidate pairs from the phase12f visualization set (20 per model; not a random sample of test pairs, so absolute values should not be read as population estimates). For each model $\times$ \{baseline, ABTT\} $\times$ method we report: \textbf{Suff@25\%}: $S_v(q_{\text{top-25\%}}, c) / S_v(q_{\text{full}}, c)$ (higher is better); restricted to pairs with $S_v(q_{\text{full}}, c) \ge 0.05$ to avoid small-denominator instability. \textbf{Comp@25\%}: relative drop when the top 25\% of tokens are masked (higher is better). \textbf{Compact@0.8}: smallest token fraction that recovers $\ge 0.8 \cdot S_v(q_{\text{full}}, c)$ (lower is better). \textbf{$\rho_{\text{LOO}}$}: Spearman correlation between $|a|$ and single-token leave-one-out $\Delta\cos$ (higher is better; tokens with $|\Delta| < 10^{-4}$ excluded as noise). \textit{random} and \textit{inverse} rows serve as lower- and upper-bound sanity checks; a useful method should beat \textit{random} on every metric, and \textit{inverse} (using $1 / (\varepsilon + |\textsc{IG}|)$ as the per-token score, so its ranking is the reverse of \textsc{IG}'s) should be the worst. Bolded values mark the best real method per (metric, variant) within each model. Cross-variant deltas conflate two effects (ABTT changes both the attribution scores and the decision function $\cos(\text{embed}_{\text{ABTT}}(q), \text{embed}_{\text{ABTT}}(c))$ being explained) and should be read as descriptive shifts on this curated set rather than as a measure of fidelity loss caused by ABTT alone. For decoder-only models (here Qwen3-0.6B), masking replaces tokens with PAD under the causal mask, which does not fully remove their influence on downstream hidden states; those rows should be interpreted with this caveat. \textsc{IG} and \textsc{OT} produce numerically identical rows because the \textsc{OT} pair-matrix uses $|\textsc{IG}|$ as transport mass and our row-sum-positive reduction recovers the same per-token magnitudes; any methodological gap between them shows up only in the pair-matrix heatmaps, not in the per-token aggregate. Per-pair rows and the full sweep over fractions $\{0.10, 0.25, 0.50\}$ are in the companion summary CSV.}
